limitations: Actual GPU-uploaded medium IDs, flags, IOR and host state are not read back by this source review; normal completion and full source-frozen image tests remain required.
This is one solid dielectric host containing smoke, not a hollow glass shell with an air cavity.
Shared smooth PLY normals all lie in their geometric hemispheres, but renderer shading-normal transport conventions and finite-precision intersection/offset behavior are not proven identical.

Engine/PBRT density and coefficient multiplication order, majorants, spectral sampling, and estimators differ. Gray optical spectra and scalar eta remove chromatic material mismatch; white-source calibration does not prove the heterogeneous transport implementation.
Depth32 source values match but convergence sufficiency remains the precommitted32-to64 rendered tail test. Source identity is not a claim of identical random samples/variance.
No normal maps/material textures are present. Ray-cone LOD does not select source texture values here, but ray offsets and normal handling still apply.

Old contract unmet text and installation INSTALLED_NOT_RENDERED are preserved historical preparation statements; this report closes only static source checks and confirms existing white-calibration provenance.
The v5 auxiliary meshlet fix applies only to bAirContributor=true pure boundaries. All four Stage3 hosts have false, retaining original loading behavior. Actual Stage2 v5 recovery remains separate.
